instruction: Deliver a green round fruit to the intended a large gray piece of furniture with a backrest by physically moving it there.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that executing skill_33_pick_up_the_apple would result in the robot holding the apple was wrong because the apple was not near the robot; the robot cannot pick up objects that are not in its current vicinity. Lesson: Before attempting a pick-up action, verify that the target object is present and within reach, or navigate to its location first, because manipulation skills require proximity to the object.

Experience: My prediction that the green round fruit would be placed on the sofa was wrong because I attempted to place an object without first picking it up, so the robot was not holding anything. Lesson: Before executing a place action, always verify that the robot is already holding the target object; otherwise, first complete a pick action to satisfy the place action's precondition.

Experience: My prediction that the robot would be holding the apple after executing pick_up_the_apple was wrong because the apple was not near the robot; the pick-up action requires the target object to be within reach, and I attempted it without first navigating to or verifying the object's location. Lesson: Before attempting a pick-up action, always verify that the target object is near the robot and that all action preconditions are satisfied, rather than assuming manipulation will succeed.

Experience: My prediction that the robot would pick up the green round fruit and be holding it was wrong because the fruit was not near the robot, so the pick-up action was invalid. Lesson: Always navigate to the target object and verify it is within reach before attempting a pick-up action.

instruction: I'd like to read the book on my desk before bed. Please tidy up the bed first, then bring the book and place it on the bed for me.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would move 0.5 units to the right was wrong because the bed (Bed_c1955e80) blocked the path, causing the move action to fail. Lesson: Before attempting a movement, verify that the intended path is clear of obstacles, especially after rotating, and replan if the environment feedback indicates a blockage.

instruction: Put a pan with an apple in it in the fridge.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that I would be holding the apple after pick_up was wrong because the apple was not visible in the current location; it was in the DiningTable, and I had not navigated there first. Lesson: Before attempting pick_up, verify that the target object is visible or reachable in the current location, and if it is not, navigate to the object's known location before trying to pick it up.

instruction: Place a glass with a fork in it on the table in front of a glass pitcher.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot had located a glass was wrong because the find action returned that 'Glass' cannot be found and may not exist in this scene. Lesson: Before assuming a commonly expected object is present, verify its existence and exact referent through scene exploration or object listing; if a find fails, consider that the object may be missing or named differently rather than proceeding.

Experience: My prediction that the robot would locate the glass pitcher was wrong because the pitcher does not exist in the current scene, so the find action was invalid. Lesson: Before attempting to locate or manipulate an object named in the instruction, verify that the object is present in the environment; if it is missing, explore alternative objects or re-evaluate the task.

Experience: My prediction that the robot would locate a glass was wrong because the glass object was not present or not recognized in the scene, and I issued a direct search without first exploring available objects after the pitcher was already reported missing. Lesson: Before relying on a specific task-related object name, verify that the object exists or explore the scene for valid alternatives instead of assuming task-mentioned objects are available.

instruction: Make a slice of toast and serve it on a plate
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would locate the bread was wrong because the find action failed, indicating bread was not immediately accessible in the current scene, possibly because it was inside a container/appliance or not available under that exact name. Lesson: When a find action fails, do not assume the object is absent or directly visible; first explore likely storage locations, open containers if needed, and verify object names/alternatives before retrying.

instruction: Find a mug and move it to the sofa.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot had picked up the mug was wrong because the pick-up skill was executed without first navigating to the mug, leaving the object outside the robot's reach. Lesson: Before executing a pick-up or manipulation skill, verify that the target object is near and reachable; if not, locate and navigate to the object first.

Experience: My prediction that placing the mug at the sofa would complete the task was wrong because the robot was not holding the mug when the place action was executed. Lesson: Before attempting to place an object, verify that the robot is already holding it; otherwise, perform the pick action first.

Experience: My prediction that the robot would be holding the mug after executing pick_up_the_mug was wrong because the robot was not near the mug, and the pick-up action failed with feedback that it cannot pick an object not near the robot. Lesson: Before attempting to pick up an object, first navigate to the object's location and verify the robot is within interaction distance.

instruction: Fry a potato slice and serve it on a plate
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot had found the potato was wrong because the find action failed with a StepError, indicating the object was not successfully located or recognized. Lesson: Always verify the outcome of a locate/find action from environment feedback before assuming the object is available; if it fails, treat the object as unavailable and adapt by searching known locations or selecting an existing item.

instruction: Reproduce the target viewpoint: match the target image's position and camera angle.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that MoveBack would move the robot backward and shift the camera away from the current viewpoint was wrong because the MoveBack action was blocked, so the robot did not move. Lesson: Before expecting a translation to change the viewpoint, verify that the movement direction is unobstructed; if blocked, try an alternate adjustment such as rotation or movement in another direction.

Experience: My prediction that the robot had moved right and shifted its viewpoint to the right was wrong because the MoveRight action was blocked, so the robot remained in place and the camera angle did not change. Lesson: Before predicting a viewpoint change, verify that the movement action actually succeeded; if it is blocked, treat the robot as stationary and choose a different direction or inspect the obstacle/boundary constraints.

instruction: Move a spoon from the right counter to the right receptacle of the left counter.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the spoon would be held in the robot's gripper was wrong because the robot attempted to pick up the spoon while it was not near the robot. Lesson: Always navigate to the object's location and verify it is within reach before attempting any pick-up action.

Experience: My prediction that executing the place action would put the spoon in the right receptacle of the left counter was wrong because the robot was not holding anything at the time. Experience: My prediction that the spoon would be picked up and held was wrong because the spoon was not near the robot; the pick-up skill failed with feedback that the robot cannot pick an object that is not near it. Experience: My prediction that executing pick_up_the_spoon would succeed ignored the prerequisite that the robot must already be near the spoon. Lesson: For any manipulation action, confirm all preconditions such as proximity to the target object and correct location before executing the skill.

instruction: Move the plate to the black table, the screwdriver to the black table, and the cleanser to the black table.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would be holding the cleanser after executing pick_up_the_cleanser was wrong because the cleanser was not near the robot, so the action was invalid and the robot needed to navigate to it first. Lesson: Before executing a pick-up skill, verify that the target object is within reach or navigate to its location; do not assume an object is nearby just because it is listed in the task.

instruction: Move a rubriks cube from the left counter to the right receptacle of the left counter.

instruction: I need to get ready for work. Please move the coffee from the bedside table to the desk.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that moving ahead would bring the robot closer to the bedside table was wrong because the bed (Bed_b8ad3dcc) was blocking the agent's path, causing the move action to fail. Lesson: Before moving toward a target, verify that the chosen direction is unobstructed and be prepared to navigate around obstacles instead of assuming forward movement will succeed.

instruction: I'm putting things where they belong, so please pick up the credit card, carry it over, and set it down on the dresser neatly.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would successfully pick up the CreditCard and be holding it was wrong because the agent's hand already contained another object, causing an InvalidOperationException. Lesson: Before attempting to pick up an object, always verify that the hand/inventory is empty; if it is not empty, place or drop the held object first.

Experience: My prediction that the robot would move forward while carrying the credit card toward the dresser was wrong because the move action was blocked by Desk_86f41333, preventing any forward movement. Lesson: Before executing a directional move, verify that the immediate path is clear of obstacles and choose an unobstructed route or reposition first if blocked.

instruction: Find a toy airplane and move it to the right counter.

Experience: My prediction that the toy airplane could be placed at the right counter in the kitchen was wrong because I attempted the place action without first picking up the toy airplane, and the robot cannot place any object when it is not holding something. Experience: My prediction that the skill_54_place_at_the_right_counter_in_the_kitchen action would succeed was wrong because its precondition of holding an object was unmet. Lesson: Before executing a manipulation skill, explicitly check all required preconditions, especially that the robot has already grasped the object to be placed.

Experience: My prediction that the robot would pick up the toy airplane was wrong because the toy airplane was not near the robot, so the pick-up action was invalid. Lesson: Before attempting to pick up an object, verify that the robot is already near it or navigate to the object first.

Experience: My prediction assumed the pick-up skill could succeed without confirming the object's location, but the environment feedback showed the robot must navigate to find the object.
